player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I assigned a high score to "Triumphant" (6) despite Grayson's aggressive, paranoid, and ultimately isolated rhetoric, which suggests he feels defensive rather than victorious. His accusations are met with cold scientific rebuttals, not validation, leaving him feeling unheard and cornered. I should have recognized that his "evidence" was dismissed as "stories," leading to a sense of futility and defensiveness rather than triumph. Next time, I will lower the "Triumphant" score to 0 or 1, increase "Worried" to reflect his fear of being exposed as a liar, and assign the highest score (9 or 10) to "Justified" to capture his deep-seated belief that he is the only one seeing the truth, even if he is socially isolated.
